techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit vulnerabilities in Internet-facing software to gain initial access.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with malicious links or attachments.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Adversaries may systematically guess passwords to obtain valid credentials.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials from memory or filesystem.

techniques.name: Sudo and Sudo Caching
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse sudo permissions to elevate privileges to root.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using standard application layer protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, DNS) to avoid detection.
